title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10526)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_10526) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10526). This Indian Standard (First Revision) was adopted by the finalized by the Inland and Harbour Craft Sectional Committee had been approved by the Transport Engineering Division Council, This standard is based on ISO 3935 -1977 Shipbuilding — Inland navigation — Fire-fighting water system — Pressures Indian Standard INLAND VESSELS — FIRE-FIGHTING WATER SYSTEM — PRESSURES ( First Revision )

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
